notes: Screenshots use staged game state; keyboard and touch tests use real input events.
Only one isolated hidden browser was used at a time; user browser windows were not controlled.

limits: Touch checks use browser emulation; physical-phone validation is not claimed.
Web Audio lifecycle can be tested automatically; audible quality and human balance need playtesting.
Best scores are local to this browser. No online leaderboard or obstacle maps.
privacy: No accounts, analytics, external runtime assets, fetched content or backend; preferences and best scores remain browser-local.

security_review.data: Browser-local settings/bests and keyboard/touch state. No account, names, imports, fetched content, secrets or backend.
security_review.untrusted_inputs: Malformed saved data and HTML-like URL/hash values tested; values are ignored or validated, and dynamic UI uses textContent.
security_review.links_and_resources: Relative local resources only. Guide opens with noopener; wiki has no scripts, forms, embeds or external links.
security_review.limits: Scoped source, negative-input and navigation checks; not a security certification. Local scores are editable and are not an online fairness boundary.
